questions.text: A project brief is incomplete and the deadline is close. What do you do first?
options: List the unknowns and confirm priorities with the owner
Wait until every detail is supplied
Start the most visible task without asking questions
Hand the project to someone else

questions.text: A teammate proposes an approach different from yours. How do you respond?
options: Compare both approaches against the project goal
Accept the new approach without reviewing it

questions.text: You notice a small mistake in work that has already been shared. What is your next step?
options: Report it promptly with a proposed correction
Ignore it because it is small
Correct it silently without informing anyone
Wait for someone else to notice

questions.text: Two assigned tasks have the same deadline. How do you choose what to do first?
options: Assess impact and urgency, then communicate the order
Switch between both tasks every few minutes
Delay both until the priority is obvious

questions.text: Describe one habit that helps you learn from feedback.
Choose the clearest sentence for a professional status update.
options: The draft is complete, and I will send it for review by 3 p.m.
I am writing to inform you that perhaps the draft could be completed.
The draft, which was drafted, has draft status.

questions.text: Complete the sentence: If I need clarification, I ___ the project owner before continuing.
Which response politely asks for more time?
options: Could I send the revised version tomorrow morning?
You gave me too little time.

questions.text: A colleague writes: ‘Please share the figures before the meeting so I can update the slides.’ What do they need?
Write a two-sentence update explaining that a task is delayed and when it will be ready.
A report takes 12 minutes to process. An improvement makes it 25% faster. How long does it take now?
Every approved request has a reference number. Request A has no reference number. Which conclusion is valid?
A team completes 18 checks in 3 hours at a steady rate. How many checks can it complete in 5 hours?
Explain how you would verify that a proposed solution addresses the original problem.
